QuestInfo.name: Bringing Back the Oldies
QuestInfo.0: Maestro Rho seems frustrated that you can't make out the difference. What can you do, really? Talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: Maestro Rho wants you to bring back Greatest Oldies so that you can listen for differences between his old and new songs.
QuestInfo.2: Well, you still can't really tell the difference. You're not really an expert anyway.

0.0: Well, I can't blame an uneducated commoner for missing the subtle differences. Maybe if you heard more of his old music, your brain would catch up? Just bring back 55 copies of his Greatest Oldies so we can find a winner.

no.0: Blake had great songs back when he made his debut. You should definitely check his early stuff out.

1.0: Ahh, here we go! Let's have a listen.

yes.0: Yeah, can't you feel it? His older songs have so much more soul. He's improved his skills, but he lost his passion. That's why I can no longer compose songs for h...you still have no idea what I'm on about, huh?

item.0: How about you bring back some of his old songs for comparison then? Just bring back 55 copies of his Greatest Oldies.
